title: Glossary of race types
note: BHA defines a Seller by the winner being offered for auction post-race and beaten horses being available to claim. Use for the British selling-race sense rather than a universal race type.

title: Changes to 2026 two-year-old programme
note: BHA explicitly divides the 2026 two-year-old novice/maiden programme into Open and Restricted categories and publishes the banding used for Restricted races. Keep these Concepts scoped to the British programme rather than globalising the labels.

title: TOBA Announces U.S. Graded and Listed Stakes for 2026
note: The American Graded Stakes Committee publishes the 2026 U.S. Grade I/II/III and Listed stakes classifications. Supports the U.S. Graded Stakes Concept and its separation from Listed status.

title: Racing Explained — Glossary
covers: Tapeta; Polytrack; Fibresand; Weigh out; Weigh in
note: The current glossary describes All Weather racing and names Fibresand, Tapeta and Polytrack as all-weather surface types; it also directly explains Weighing In/Out before and after a race.

title: BHA confirms six fixture alterations
note: BHA states that Southwell's all-weather surface was being changed from Fibresand to Tapeta, supporting both product labels and Fibresand's historical British use.

title: Gulfstream Park chart — 4 September 2026 Race 2
note: Current Equibase chart publishes Track: Muddy (Sealed), establishing Sealed as an operational North American track-state label without implying one universal maintenance procedure.

title: Pennine Ridge contest moved off the turf
note: NYRA describes a race originally scheduled for turf being moved to a dirt contest because of rain, supporting the North American moved/off-turf sense.

title: Racing Post — how to read results
note: JRA's Racing Post guide maps y to yard with metric conversion and shd to short head / 短アタマ in British results.

title: Section 3 — The Racecourse
note: BHA racecourse instructions use furlong and half-furlong marker requirements in the closing part of the course. Supports final-furlong course-stage terminology in British racing.

title: Caulfield race programme — 4 April 2026
note: Current Racing Australia programme publishes maximum/minimum weight conditions. Exact values and use remain race- and jurisdiction-specific.

title: Racing Explained — Weighing In/Out
note: The Jockey Club directly explains official pre-race and post-race weighing of jockey, kit and saddle by the Clerk of the Scales.

title: Rules of Racing — Part 16 Weighing in
note: BHA rules explicitly address disqualification for an underweight rider / a horse carrying less weight than required. Consequences remain rule- and jurisdiction-specific.

title: The Valley published form — 6 October 2023
note: Official Racing Australia published form uses bottom weight in race analysis for the lightest end of the handicap scale. Supports the regional racing term without asserting a universal rule definition.
